configuration: Upstream P2 two-dimensional DG Maxwell waveguide mode (70x50 cells) through ten periods with no kinetic species.
observable: the final field frame and the complete field-energy history
variant: ic/variant/value.txt changes epsilon0 from 1.0 to 1.0000000000000004, exactly two upward binary64 ULP.
altbuild: run.sh altbuild runs the nominal inputs on the same pinned source compiled strict-IEEE with the same gcc (-O2, no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native: the build-ieee/ tree of the oracle image); a correct port compiled without fast-math or FMA contraction is exactly such a build, so its distance from the default -O3 -ffast-math -march=native build is the floor a candidate must be allowed.

files.timestamps: matched on the recorded physical time within time_tolerance_fraction of the window; a non-finite or out-of-order time axis on either side fails the file

evidence.floor_how: measured by selfcheck on 2026-09-07: run.sh altbuild (same source, gcc -O2 strict IEEE: no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native (build-ieee/)) against run.sh nominal, graded with the check's own validate.py: all graded values within bound

altbuild.what: same source, gcc -O2 strict IEEE: no -ffast-math, -ffp-contract=off, no -march=native (build-ieee/)

warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the standalone DG Maxwell solver of the vlasov app in two dimensions, a blind spot the module's previous check set named. In `rt_dg_maxwell_wg_2d.c`, `epsilon0` (line 60) is the permittivity, which sets the wave speed; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong Maxwell flux, a wrong divergence-cleaning potential or a wrong two-dimensional field update changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 3.7e-3 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 4.0e-3 (worst files `field-energy.gkyl` and `field-energy.gkyl`), a headroom of about 252x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
